facts.statement: The species Helonetta brodkorpi was described by Emslie in 1992.
facts.quote:
genus: Helonetta
species: brodkorpi
authority: Emslie, 1992

facts.statement: Helonetta lived during the Late Pliocene.
Helonetta brodkorpi is known from the Tamiami Formation of Florida.
facts.quote: Helonetta brodkorpi is known from the Tamiami Formation of Florida.

facts.statement: Helonetta belongs to the subfamily Anatinae, the family Anatidae, and the class Aves.
facts.quote:
Parent group: Anatinae
Family: Anatidae
Class: Aves

facts.statement: Helonetta lived from 4.7 to 1.4 million years ago, spanning the Zanclean to Calabrian ages.
facts.quote: Time range: Zanclean to Calabrian (4.7 to 1.4 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Helonetta is an extinct genus of anatid that lived during the Piacenzian stage of the Pliocene epoch.
rejected.quote: Helonetta is an extinct genus of anatid that lived during the Piacenzian stage of the Pliocene epoch.
